name: grand-to-ground
description: An adversarial, Lakatos-inspired research loop for AI-assisted social science, in two modes. The research cycle turns a grand framework into one identifiable, falsifiable question: parallel deduction, a three-critic tribunal, grounding, tick-to-approve plans. The Theory Forge builds a system: propositions checked one by one at a cold-start verification gate, entered into a proposition graph with cascade revocation. One line ("run G2G") starts it; unattended runs are bounded by account usage.
